PROP-e5782b58-asm-003.text: Supabase admin client (service_role key) must never be exposed to client-side code.
PROP-e5782b58-asm-003.assertion: service_role_key not present in client bundles or browser-accessible code

locations.note: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY (no NEXT_PUBLIC_ prefix) is only accessed server-side. createAdminClient is server-only ('use server' implied by being in /lib/supabase/server.ts with cookies() import).
Differentiates anon key (NEXT_PUBLIC_) vs service role key (private) based on isAdmin flag. Service role key path at line 12-13.
